games.headline: Ty Jerome scores 29, Cam Spencer has 24 as Grizzlies hand Hornets their 5th straight loss, 117-111
games.desc: — Ty Jerome made seven 3-pointers and finished with 29 points, and the Memphis Grizzlies handed the Charlotte Hornets their fifth straight loss, 117-111 on Monday night.

games.headline: Deni Avdija hits 5 3s and scores 31 points as Trail Blazers hand 76ers only their 4th loss, 128-111
games.desc: — Deni Avdija scored 31 points and hit five of Portland's 19 3-pointers to lead the Trail Blazers to a 128-111 win over the Philadelphia 76ers on Monday night.

games.headline: Siakam scores 20 and comes up big late as Pacers snap 4-game skid with 125-120 win over Thunder
games.desc: — Pascal Siakam scored 20 points, including a 3-pointer with 44.4 seconds to go, and Kelly Oubre Jr. added a season-high 20 points to help the Indiana Pacers snap a four-game losing streak with a 125-120 victory over the Oklahoma City Thunder on...

games.headline: Herro scores 32 points, Turner adds 27 as Bucks beat Raptors 116-111 to snap 13-game losing streak
games.desc: — Tyler Herro scored 32 points, Myles Turner fouled out with a season-high 27 and the Milwaukee Bucks snapped a 13-game losing streak by beating the Toronto Raptors 116-111 on Monday night.

games.headline: Jaden McDaniels scores career-best 34 for Timberwolves in 142-116 rout of Nets
games.desc: — Jaden McDaniels scored a career-best 34 points and the Minnesota Timberwolves routed the Brooklyn Nets 142-116 on Monday night.

games.headline: Bulls beat Cavaliers 122-108 behind Jordan Hawkins' 19 points and 63 off the bench
games.desc: — Jordan Hawkins scored a season-high 19 points, Buddy Hield had 17 and the Chicago Bulls got 63 points off the bench as they held on to beat the Cleveland Cavaliers 122-108 on Monday night.

games.headline: Jalen Green scores 25 and Devin Booker adds 22 to help the Suns top the Pelicans 123-119 in OT
games.desc: — Jalen Green scored 25 points, Devin Booker added 22, and the Phoenix Suns defeated the New Orleans Pelicans, 123-119 in overtime on Monday night.

games.headline: Kevin Durant scores 32 to power Rockets past Clippers 116-104
games.desc: — Kevin Durant scored 32 points and Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson each had 20 to lead the Houston Rockets to a 116-104 win over the Los Angeles Clippers on Monday night.

games.headline: Luka Doncic scores 28, Lakers avenge loss to Jazz last week with 109-94 victory in rematch
games.desc: — Luka Doncic had 28 points and eight assists, Jake LaRavia added 15 points and 10 rebounds, and the Los Angeles Lakers avenged a surprising home loss to the Jazz five days earlier with a 109-94 victory over Utah on Monday night.

games.headline: Castle helps Spurs stay unbeaten on road with 123-107 win over Kings minus Wemby, Fox and Harper
